The '''H'ken system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained a twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-wide [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt that was used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] for training purposes. A squadron of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] was [[Battle of H'ken asteroid belt|destroyed]] in the system by members of the [[Restored Empire]].
